parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a detachable top cover of the kettle, typically made of stainless steel to resist heat and corrosion.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the kettle opening to retain heat and prevent spillage while boiling water.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is an insulated grip attached to the kettle body, made of heat-resistant Bakelite.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to safely hold and pour the kettle without direct contact with the hot surface.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the kettle, made of stainless steel for durability and heat conduction.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the water and transfers heat from the heating source to boil it.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main structural component.
